items.description: This repository provides an example implementation of an LLM-based feedback system for clinical case report writing.  The system connects Slack, Google Apps Script (GAS), and Dify to deliver structured feedback to novice rehabilitation staff, supporting scalable and reproducible educational use.

items.name: 6f02d74f-ai-writing-coach-chrome-extens
items.description: Real-time AI writing coach for your browser. Get instant feedback on tone, clarity, and impact—works on Gmail, LinkedIn, Slack, and everywhere you write.
